newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: EEI SIGNS CONSTRUCTION PACT WITH MITSUBISHI.
newsitem.headline: EEI SIGNS CONSTRUCTION PACT WITH MITSUBISHI.

text.p: Philippine engineering firm EEI Corp said on Tuesday it had signed a construction agreement with Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd.
In a statement, EEI said the contract involved the construction of module assembly works for power plant projects contracted to Mitsubishi for a period of five years.

"This contract represents a major corporate stride and a testament to the confidence of international principals on the technical superiority of EEI's management and organisation ," EEI president Rogelio Murga said.
